versos.grego: Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν Πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα· δόξασόν σου τὸν Υἱόν, ἵνα ὁ Υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ,

controles.web: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
controles.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
controles.livre: Jesus falou estas coisas, levantou seus olhos ao céu, e disse: Pai, chegada é a hora; glorifica a teu Filho, para que também teu Filho glorifique a ti.

versos.grego: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ δώσῃ αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
controles.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
controles.livre: Assim como lhe deste poder sobre toda carne, para que a todos quantos lhe deste, lhes dê a vida eterna.

versos.grego: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωὴ, ἵνα γινώσκωσιν σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν Θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν.

controles.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
controles.livre: E esta é a vida eterna: que conheçam a ti, o único Deus verdadeiro, e a Jesus Cristo, a quem tens enviado.

versos.grego: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὸ ἔργον τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω·

controles.web: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
controles.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
controles.livre: Eu já te glorifiquei na terra; consumado tenho a obra que me deste para eu fazer.

versos.grego: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ, Πάτερ, παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί.

controles.web: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
controles.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
controles.livre: E agora glorifica-me tu, ó Pai, junto de ti mesmo, com aquela glória que eu tinha junto de ti, antes que o mundo existisse.

versos.grego: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου. σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ἔδωκας, καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν.

controles.web: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
controles.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
controles.livre: Manifestei teu nome aos seres humanos que me deste do mundo. Eles eram teus, e tu os deste a mim; e eles guardaram tua palavra.

versos.grego: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα δέδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ εἰσιν·

controles.web: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
controles.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
controles.livre: Agora eles sabem que tudo quanto me deste vem de ti.

versos.grego: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον, καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

controles.web: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you, and they have believed that you sent me.
controles.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
controles.livre: Porque as palavras que tu me deste eu lhes dei; e eles as receberam, e verdadeiramente reconheceram que eu saí de ti, e creram que tu me enviaste.

versos.grego: Ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ· οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ, ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι σοί εἰσιν,

controles.web: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
controles.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
controles.livre: Eu rogo por eles; não rogo pelo mundo, mas sim por aqueles que tu me deste, porque são teus.

versos.grego: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά, καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
controles.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
controles.livre: E todas as minhas coisas são tuas; e as tuas coisas são minhas; e nelas sou glorificado.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν, κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι. Πάτερ ἅγιε, τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς.

controles.web: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
controles.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
controles.livre: E eu já não estou no mundo; porém estes ainda estão no mundo, e eu venho a ti. Pai Santo, guarda-os em teu nome, a aqueles que tens me dado, para que sejam um, como nós somos .

versos.grego: ὅτε ἤμην μετ’ αὐτῶν, ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, καὶ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ.

controles.web: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
controles.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
controles.livre: Quando eu com eles estava no mundo, em teu nome eu os guardava. A aqueles que tu me deste eu os tenho guardado; e nenhum deles se perdeu, a não ser o filho da perdição, para que a Escritura se cumpra.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι, καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

controles.web: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
controles.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
controles.livre: Mas agora venho a ti, e falo isto no mundo, para que em si mesmos tenham minha alegria completa.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

controles.web: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
controles.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
controles.livre: Tua palavra lhes dei, e o mundo os odiou, porque não são do mundo, assim como eu não sou do mundo.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου, ἀλλ’ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

controles.web: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
controles.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
controles.livre: Não suplico que os tires do mundo, mas que os guardes do maligno.

versos.grego: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

controles.web: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.
controles.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
controles.livre: Eles não são do mundo, assim como eu não sou do mundo.

versos.grego: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ· ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.

controles.web: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
controles.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
controles.livre: Santifica-os em tua verdade; tua palavra é a verdade.

versos.grego: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον, κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον·

controles.web: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
controles.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
controles.livre: Assim como tu me enviaste, eu os enviei ao mundo.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.

controles.web: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
controles.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
controles.livre: E por eles a mim mesmo me santifico, para que também eles seja santificados em verdade.

versos.grego: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ,

controles.web: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,
controles.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
controles.livre: E não suplico somente por estes, mas também por aqueles que crerão em mim, por sua palavra.

versos.grego: ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν, καθὼς σύ, Πατήρ, ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ὦσιν, ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

controles.web: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
controles.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
controles.livre: Para que todos sejam um; como tu, Pai, em mim, e eu em ti, que também eles em nós sejam um; para que o mundo creia que tu tens me enviado.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν·

controles.web: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
controles.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
controles.livre: E eu tenho lhes dado a glória que tu me deste, para que sejam um, tal como nós somos um.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί, ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν, ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας.

controles.web: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.
controles.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
controles.livre: Eu neles, e tu em mim; para que sejam completos em um; e para que o mundo conheça que tu me enviaste, e que tu os amaste, assim como me amaste.

versos.grego: Πατήρ, ὃ δέδωκάς μοι, θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν, ἣν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

controles.web: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
controles.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
controles.livre: Pai, aqueles que tens me dado, quero que onde eu estiver, eles também estejam comigo; para que vejam minha glória, que tens me dado, pois tu me amaste desde antes da fundação do mundo.

versos.grego: Πατὴρ δίκαιε, καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω, ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων, καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας·

controles.web: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
controles.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
controles.livre: Pai justo, o mundo também não tem te conhecido, e estes têm conhecido que tu me enviaste.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω, ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
controles.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
controles.livre: E eu fiz teu nome ser conhecido por eles, e eu farei com que seja conhecido, para que o amor com que me amaste esteja neles, e eu neles.
